description.value: Gramma's Pub is a waterfront sports bar in Gibsons, BC, established in 1989, with an enclosed patio overlooking Shoal Channel, Keat's Island, and Gibsons Harbour. It offers one of the largest rotating on-tap draught selections on the Sunshine Coast, drawing from local craft breweries alongside national and international brands. Cyclists riding the Lower Sunshine Coast will find a full scratch kitchen, weekly specials, and a warm, low-key atmosphere steps from the waterfront seawall.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live with 2026 menus and a May 2026 events calendar, confirming current operation. Takeout is explicitly confirmed on the menu page ('All menu items at Gramma's are available as Takeout or Dine-In'). Vegan options are evidenced by the Sunday special listing 'vegan Bratwurst' and '(vf)' pierogi; no bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but Gibsons is on the Sunshine Coast (Lower Mainland), not Vancouver Island — may cause directory mis-categorization.
COVID-19 safety messaging ('KEEPING YOUR HEALTH SAFETY IN MIND WITH SANITIZING, MASKS & BARRIERS') remains on the homepage and appears outdated; otherwise site content appears current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established waterfront pub with takeout, scratch kitchen, and seawall access in Gibsons — a key stop on the Lower Sunshine Coast cycling route. Inclusion is worthwhile even with limited confirmed cycling amenities.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Sunday special lists 'vegan Bratwurst' as an add-on option and '(vf)' pierogi (caramelized onion), indicating vegan-friendly items on the menu
